title: IndexError
kicker: Python for SDFs · Fix the error
code:
doc_types = ["Cover Letter", "Certificate of Quality", "BSE/TSE Declaration"]
last_type = doc_types[3]
print(last_type)
traceback: IndexError: list index out of range

notes.label: IndexError
notes.text: The type of error. You asked a list for a position it doesn't have.

notes.label: list index out of range
notes.text: The reason. This list has 3 items, at positions 0, 1 and 2. Position 3 would be a fourth item, and there isn't one.

fixes.label: last_type = doc_types[-1]
fixes.title: Best fix
fixes.feedback: `-1` means the last item, however long the list is. `doc_types[2]` works for this list too, but `[-1]` keeps working when the next SDF has more document types. Output: `BSE/TSE Declaration`
fixes.fixed_code:
doc_types = ["Cover Letter", "Certificate of Quality", "BSE/TSE Declaration"]
last_type = doc_types[-1]
print(last_type)

fixes.label: last_type = doc_types[len(doc_types)]
fixes.title: Still an IndexError
fixes.feedback: `len(doc_types)` is 3, so this asks for position 3 again. The last position is always one less than the length.
fixes.fixed_code:
doc_types = ["Cover Letter", "Certificate of Quality", "BSE/TSE Declaration"]
last_type = doc_types[len(doc_types)]
print(last_type)

fixes.label: last_type = doc_types[3:]
fixes.title: The error goes away, but the answer is wrong
fixes.feedback: A slice never raises an IndexError. It returns whatever is in that range, and nothing starts at position 3, so this prints an empty list: `[]`.
fixes.fixed_code:
doc_types = ["Cover Letter", "Certificate of Quality", "BSE/TSE Declaration"]
last_type = doc_types[3:]
print(last_type)
